GET /pp/routines/today.returns: { routine_id, child_id, date, greeting, plan: [{ module, icon, duration_min, is_challenge, status }] }

POST /pp/sessions/start.returns: { session_id, child_id, status, current_phase, phases[], total_progress_pct }

GET /pp/progress/weekly.description: Dashboard semanal con métricas y módulos
GET /pp/progress/weekly.returns: { child_id, week, sessions_completed, streak, metrics: { attention_pct, attention_trend }, avg_score, modules: [{ module_id, name, icon, score, sessions }], daily, message, recommendation }

GET /pp/rewards/:child_id.returns: { child_id, stars, seeds, chest: { current, to_fill, filled, pct }, stage: { name, emoji, number }, next_stage }

GET /pp/calm/exercises.returns: [{ id, name, slug, description, duration_min, icon, audience }]

POST /pp/emotional-states.body: { recorded_by, mood, context, organization_id, family_id, parent_id, child_id, session_id }

GET /pp/families/:id.returns: { id, name, status, parents: [{ id, name, role }], children: [{ id, name, age, avatar, active_modules }] }

GET /pp/children/:id.returns: { id, name, age, avatar, accessibility_mode, active_modules, streak, rewards }
